# Claude Mem — Project Memory Config

Claude Mem provides persistent memory across sessions.

## Install

```bash
npx -y claude-mem@latest
```

## Usage

Reference this file from your agent config. Claude Mem stores conversation context and user preferences locally.

## Recommended settings

- Enable auto-recall for project-specific facts
- Scope memory to this repository
- Review stored memories periodically

Docs: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem
